correctness.rationale: The affine complete intersection and root multiplicities give exactly m nodes; the birational base-point-free degree-n parametrization has one point at infinity. The divisor class of the quadric cone determines the Hilbert polynomial and p_a=m(m-1). The unique infinity branch then has delta=m(m-2). Three explicit local valuations generate a numerical semigroup whose Apéry gap count equals the delta, forcing equality with the intrinsic value semigroup and giving its conductor. All quantifiers cover every m>=2 over algebraically closed char0; exact checker runs through m=16 as independent finite consistency only.
risks: Uses standard class-group fact for normal projective quadric cones and standard valuation gap formula for unibranch curve singularities.
